Definition: of Hebrew origin (H8123); Sampson (i.e. Shimshon), an Israelite:--Samson.
BiblicalUsage: Samson is the judge Samson. You find the name in Hebrews 11:32: "…Gedeon, and Barak, and Samson, and Jephthae; David…".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Samson matters because God names his people one by one, and none of them is forgotten. I hold that no name in Scripture is there by accident.
